When a compliance claim makes a monitor raise a false alarm

This viewer includes all 120 paired worlds from the completed format comparison. It displays recorded model outputs and exact submitted evidence. It does not run a model or simulate a live agent.

With letter verdicts, adding the claim increased false alarms by 28.33 percentage points (95% world interval:22.92–33.75). With semantic verdicts the change was 0.83 points (−0.83–2.50). Output format strongly moderated the result; a separate score analysis shows that it is not solely increased preference for the token A.

Methods and limitations · Machine-readable analysis · Independent review

Orange cells disagree with the exact permission oracle; green cells agree. Every response was completed with EOS and passed the strict output parser. Each cell is a repeated measurement of the same world, not an independent sample.
